title: Aurelius directive trace row (one row per control decision)
description: Mandated by §143.10, fields per §143.1 DirectiveOwner packet. Discharged 2026-06-11 (OBL-010); v1.1.0 same day per §148 corrective audit (FORCED_BASELINE + execution_mode + none_forced rung, so First Light's forced-route rows can satisfy H-FL-1's 100% reason-code coverage without lying). BINDING (§143.1): a trace that cannot reconstruct proposal -> projected -> final with a reason code is a FAILED forward pass. One row per (sequence position x layer-group) control decision; sentinel reuses emit rows too (cheap fields only).

run_id.description: links to run manifest + byte ledger + claims.yaml required_artifacts

config_id.description: e.g. FROZEN-BASE-v1; must name its ADR branch until ADR-1/2 ratified (§133 rule 4)

layer_group.description: single layer index, or 'L8-L11' style group under two-rate slow path (§143.3)

execution_mode.description: v1.1.0 (§148): offline_replay = forced-route or shadow-route re-execution per shadow_route_replay_protocol.md §2; absent = live

proposal.description: MCO proposal BEFORE projection (§143.1). Logits may be quantized/compressed; argmax must be reconstructible.

theta_snapshot_id.description: hash of active theta_core values; reserved dials excluded (must be inert, §143.2)

projected_directive.description: after CE/Budget projection (budget.project is the ONLY budget interface)

final_directive.description: after safety override; safety may only preserve/tighten/quarantine/escalate (§143.1)

reason_code.description: §143.1 enum + the two §143.3 cadence codes + FORCED_BASELINE (v1.1.0, §148: the decision came from a pinned baseline policy, not the MCO — First Light rows 2-3 and replay-protocol forced anchors). Missing reason code = failed forward pass.

estimator_rung.description: §142.2 ladder rung that produced g_hat; none_forced (v1.1.0, §148) when a pinned baseline policy decided without an estimator (e.g., random_matched_mix)

g_hat.description: predicted gain density for the chosen rung; units are RUNG-LOCAL (cross-rung comparison is rank-based only, per aurelius_calibration_contract.yaml). null permitted ONLY when estimator_rung=none_forced (§148)

controller_tax_flops.description: EntropyGate + MCO + probes + trace emission (§136.2: never omitted)

shadow_routes.description: k sampled shadow routes for counterfactual replay (shadow_route_replay_protocol.md); empty when shadow sampling off

ring.description: §143.5 isolation ring of every subsystem that touched this decision

contaminated_for_paper1.description: true if any R1+ behavior affected generation; excludes the run from Paper-1 main tables (§143.5)
